summary.text: Marj Fogelman is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 21B, with a tenure beginning in 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Fogelman is a business owner with an associate degree in accounting.

paragraphs.text: Marj Fogelman earned an associate degree in accounting from Southwestern Technical College.
Her career experience includes owning a business.
Fogelman succeeded Steve Drazkowski in District 21B and took office on January 3, 2023.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Education Policy, Capital Investment (as co-vice chair) and Transportation Finance and Policy committees.
